findings.title: Lead time: the site shows an invented 6–12 weeks, while the owner's own FAQ says 2–3 weeks
findings.why_it_matters: A homeowner with a build schedule treats lead time as a go/no-go question. The /process page adds up to roughly 6–12 weeks after consultation, /commissions adds a '2-4 week design phase', and the FAQ, where they would look, leaves the question out. That gives three different answers or none at the exact moment they are deciding. It may also drive away buyers whose schedule fits the real 2–3 weeks.
findings.evidence: src/app/process/page.tsx:33-38 has a 'Timeline' list: 'Custom mould creation: 2-4 weeks', 'Casting and curing: 3-6 weeks', 'Hand finishing and detailing: 1-2 weeks'. None of this is in scraped-data.json. src/app/commissions/page.tsx:16 still has the feature '2-4 week design phase' (working tree, after task #2). The comment at src/app/faq/page.tsx:19-20 says lead time is left out 'until the owner reconciles them with the current copy', but the current copy is the invented part. Scraped /faq: 'What is the lead time for my mantel? Our cast stone items are a custom product made by hand. With that in mind, please allow 2 to 3 weeks for production and installation of your fireplace mantel. If you require a different time frame, please let us know and we will do whatever we can to accommodate you.' Scraped /design-manufacturing-process step 6: 'The molds are then left to dry for approximately one day depending on the particular detail.'
findings.proposal: Agent now (no new facts): delete the Timeline block at process/page.tsx:32-40 and the '2-4 week design phase' feature at commissions/page.tsx:16. Owner via the Fable handoff: confirm that 2–3 weeks is still current. Once confirmed, add the FAQ item verbatim after 'How is the fireplace mantel delivered?' in the faqs[] array in faq/page.tsx; it flows into the FAQPage JSON-LD automatically. Then reuse a one-line version, 'Please allow 2 to 3 weeks for production and installation of your fireplace mantel', in the ordering steps (next finding) and under Available Options in ProductModal for mantels. If the owner gives a different figure, use theirs everywhere instead.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/faq, 'What is the lead time for my mantel?' (verbatim above); https://www.101caststone.com/design-manufacturing-process step 6

findings.title: 'What happens after I inquire?' has no single sourced answer; three invented four-step 'methods' stand in for it
findings.why_it_matters: The lens asks whether a homeowner and designer understand what happens after they inquire. Today the home, /commissions and /process each describe a different invented 'Dialogue / Mould / Cast / Finish' method. The contact page and product dialog, where the decision is made, give no next steps at all. The real steps exist in the owner's FAQ and process pages: a site visit to measure, design confirmation, production, and delivery and installation by their own crew. Those are the most reassuring facts the company has.
findings.evidence: Home, src/app/page.tsx:117-128, 'The Lintel Method': 'Dialogue — we listen and draw… Finish — hand-tooled to whisper'. src/app/commissions/page.tsx:118-124, 'The Commission Process' 01–04, including 'Mineral aggregates, careful formulation' and 'Applied patinas where appropriate'. src/app/process/page.tsx:16, 'The Lintel Method', plus the 'Materials' list. None of this is in the scrape. Sourced steps already exist in process/page.tsx 'What to Expect' (the 6 items) and in the FAQ answers for order, measure, install and deliver. /contact (contact/page.tsx) and ProductModal.tsx end at the form or button with nothing about what follows. On mobile, the home page's text-only Workshop/pillars/Lintel stretch runs from y≈3,170 to y≈5,535.
findings.proposal: Create src/components/OrderingSteps.tsx with five sourced steps. 1 'Contact us via phone, email or the contact form, and we will walk you through the entire process.' 2 'If you are local to our area of California, our sales staff will schedule an appointment to visit your residence or jobsite to verify the measurements. Out of the area? Our sales staff will review your Fireplace Surround Worksheet with you to confirm accuracy.' 3 'You review and confirm the final design before production begins.' 4 'Each piece is cast in the color you specify, packed by hand into the mold and checked by Quality Control.' 5 'Fireplace products are quoted with installation by our team; our crew delivers the mantel at the time of installation.' Add the lead-time line once the owner confirms it. Render the component in five places: (a) /contact, as 'What happens next' beside the form; (b) ProductModal, compact, for mantels; (c) the home page, replacing the three pillars and The Lintel Method (page.tsx:100-128); (d) /commissions, replacing 'The Commission Process' (118-124); (e) /process, replacing the Lintel intro and Materials list (16-30). Drop the made-up 'Lintel Method' name everywhere it appears.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: Scraped /faq: 'How do I order a Fireplace Mantel?', 'How do I measure my Fireplace?', 'Who installs the fireplace products?', 'How is the Fireplace Mantel delivered?'. Scraped /design-manufacturing-process steps 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8. The existing sourced 'What to Expect' list in src/app/process/page.tsx.

findings.title: Home first screen: on a laptop the first 900px are one photo with no headline, no product words and no call to action
findings.why_it_matters: An HNW homeowner or designer judges a site in seconds. On desktop the whole first screen is a lifestyle photo, with only the header button. On a phone the word 'mantel' first appears about two screens down. The subhead is abstract marketing that says nothing about what is made or where. Benchmark sites state the product and give a route into the range above the fold.
findings.evidence: src/app/page.tsx:15: the hero is md:h-screen (878px tall at 1440×900), and the H1 'Where Craft Becomes Legacy' sits at y=1,061, below the fold. On mobile the H1 is at y=652 and the first 'mantel' wording is in the Signature Collections card, around y=1,700. The subhead at page.tsx:35-36, 'hand-finished with 21st-century precision… visionaries who prefer silence to spectacle', is not in the scrape. The hero alt at page.tsx:19 reads 'Wine country estate with architectural cast stone elements', but the photo shows a couple holding wine beside a pale stone mantel set in a fieldstone wall, with a dining room behind. The owner chose this image (commit 7ad0706), so keep it.
findings.proposal: In page.tsx, cap the hero at md:h-[72vh] and move the H1 block (the H1, a sourced subhead and two CTAs) so it falls inside the first 900px, either overlaid on the lower part of the hero or directly under a shorter hero. Subhead: 'Quality cast stone products for architectural construction, landscape enhancement, and beautiful European-style fireplace surrounds and mantels.' CTA 1: 'View fireplace mantels' → /collections#mantels. CTA 2: 'Visit the showroom' → #showroom (see the showroom finding). Change the alt to 'A couple holding glasses of wine beside a pale stone fireplace mantel set in a fieldstone wall, with a dining room behind them'.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/about-us tagline: 'Quality cast stone products for architectural construction, landscape enhancement, and beautiful European-style fireplace surrounds and mantels.' The alt text describes only what is visible in public/images/hero/winecountry.jpg.

findings.title: A designer can't specify a color: 3 of the 7 swatches, texture samples in an unnamed peach tone, and no path from a model to the swatches
findings.why_it_matters: Color and texture are the second decision after the silhouette, and designers specify by name. The product dialog promises 'Seven standard colors and three texture finishes', but the site shows three named colors. The texture photos are a peach tone that matches none of them, so they read as a fourth color. Confidence drops exactly where the designer has to commit.

findings.proposal: Agent now: in ProductModal, link the colors line to /collections#finishes (close the dialog first, as the FAQ link does). Under Available Options add the sourced line 'We can also produce custom colors and texture finishes – call us to discuss your specific requirements', with a tel link (number per the founding-year/phone finding). Change the caption at collections/page.tsx:164 to 'Texture samples are shown in a single color, which may differ from the swatches.' Owner via the Fable handoff: supply all seven color names and swatch photos (the uncropped chart or the physical board), and ideally the three textures photographed in one named standard color. Then extend stoneColors to seven and delete the 'three of the seven' note.

findings.title: Check that inquiries actually arrive: without the Resend settings, every form submission is pushed to the visitor's email app
findings.why_it_matters: Inquiries are the site's whole job. If production lacks the email settings, every visitor gets 'Almost there — Your inquiry hasn't been sent yet' and has to send it from their own email app. Many phone users drop off at that step. The page also promises 'We typically respond within 1–2 business days' three times, and nothing in the source supports that promise.
findings.evidence: src/app/api/inquiry/route.ts returns 503 when RESEND_API_KEY or INQUIRY_FROM_EMAIL is unset. InquiryForm.tsx then shows the 'fallback' panel and a mailto link. The repo has no .env.local (as expected), and .env.example lists the three variables. Delivery defaults to info@101caststone.com (lib/inquiry.ts:4). That address is not in scraped-data.json (0 '@' hits); the owner added it in commit 4a6fd07 'Add real contact info from 101caststone.com'. The 1–2 business days line appears at ProductModal.tsx:110 and InquiryForm.tsx:150 and :328, and is not in the scrape.
findings.proposal: Owner via the Fable handoff, deployment only: in Vercel set RESEND_API_KEY and INQUIRY_FROM_EMAIL (an address on a 101caststone.com domain verified in Resend), plus INQUIRY_TO_EMAIL if the inbox the staff actually read is not info@. Submit one test inquiry from a phone and confirm it arrives. Confirm the '1–2 business days' promise: keep it only if staff will honour it, otherwise replace it with the sourced 'Please call us … if you have other questions'. No code change is needed.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: None (deployment and owner confirmation). Fallback wording, if the promise is dropped, from https://www.101caststone.com/faq intro: 'Please call us at (805) 460-6060 if you have other questions, or if you wish to discuss your unique project requirements.'

findings.title: The showroom visit isn't something a visitor can act on: called 'Studio', missing from the home page, and the form can't request a weekend appointment or a site measure
findings.why_it_matters: An HNW client choosing a mantel for a new house wants to see the stone in person. The live site put 'Atascadero Showroom… Factory Showroom Hours… Weekend Appointments Available' on every page, and benchmark sites lead with 'visit a showroom'. In the build the showroom appears only in the footer (as 'Studio') and on /about, which a phone's tab bar doesn't link to. The form has no way to ask for a weekend appointment, or for the local site visit the FAQ promises.
findings.evidence: Live footer on every scraped page: 'Atascadero Showroom / 1720 El Camino Real…', 'Factory Showroom Hours: Monday-Friday: 8am to 5pm / Weekend Appointments Available'. Build: footer heading 'Studio' (layout.tsx:149); contact 'Studio Location' and metadata title 'Visit Our Atascadero Studio' (contact/page.tsx:36 and :7). Home (page.tsx) never mentions a showroom. /about 'Visit the Atascadero showroom' is at y≈3,495 on mobile, and MobileBottomNav (Navigation.tsx) has only Collections, Works, Process, Commissions and Contact. PROJECT_TYPE_OPTIONS in lib/inquiry.ts has no visit or measure option.
findings.proposal: (1) Rename 'Studio' to 'Showroom' in layout.tsx:149 and contact/page.tsx:7 and :36. (2) Add a home section id='showroom' before the final CTA: H2 'Visit the Atascadero showroom'; '1720 El Camino Real, Atascadero, CA 93422 · Monday–Friday 8am to 5pm · Weekend appointments available'; a Get directions link reusing DIRECTIONS_URL; and a button 'Request a weekend appointment' → /contact?product=Showroom%20visit. (3) In lib/inquiry.ts add a 'Showroom visit' option to PROJECT_TYPE_OPTIONS, or a new optional 'I'd like to' select with 'Request a quote', 'Arrange a site measure (local)' and 'Visit the showroom'. Update inquiry.test.ts and composeInquiryEmail labels to match. (4) Consider swapping the text-only 'Commissions' tab in MobileBottomNav for 'Visit' or 'About'.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: Footer on every scraped page ('Atascadero Showroom', 'Factory Showroom Hours', 'Monday-Friday: 8am to 5pm', 'Weekend Appointments Available'). findings.title: Founding year and main phone number contradict the owner's own site
findings.why_it_matters: Trust is everything in a high-ticket purchase, and planners check. Every page header says 'Est. 2001', but the owner's About text says the company started in 2006; the build's About page quietly leaves the year out. The live site's main 'call us' number appears nowhere in the build.
findings.evidence: 'Est. 2001' appears at layout.tsx:97 (header, every page) and :126 (footer), in the meta description (layout.tsx:16 'Serving California since 2001'), in StructuredData.tsx:10 and :14 (foundingDate '2001'), at contact/page.tsx:81, and is baked into public/images/logos/101timelesslogo.png (renders 'EST. 2001' in the home CTA panel). Scraped /about-us: 'Clark Baird started 101 Cast Stone in the summer of 2006.' Phone: every live page lists '(805) 460-6060' under 'Atascadero Showroom', and every body CTA says 'call us at (805) 460-6060'; '(805) 610-9278' is a second number. The build uses only 610-9278 (layout footer, contact, FAQ, InquiryForm, StructuredData telephone).
findings.proposal: Owner decision, via the Fable handoff. (1) Which founding year is right? If 2006, change all 7 places plus the logo asset. If 2001 is right (for example an earlier entity), give the source so /about can say so. (2) Which number rings the showroom? Make that one primary in the header/contact/JSON-LD and show the other as secondary. Agent meanwhile: change nothing that would mean guessing. The only safe interim edit is dropping 'since 2001' from the layout.tsx:16 meta description.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/about-us ('summer of 2006'); the live footer on every page (both phone numbers).

findings.title: The photos undersell the product next to the benchmark sites; testimonials and named projects are missing
findings.why_it_matters: For an HNW homeowner and their designer, photography is the evidence of quality. All 11 models are shown only in phone snapshots of builder-grade rooms, often with a TV mounted above and a gas-insert log set. Haddonstone and Chesney's lead with styled, consistently lit shots and named projects. The live site had a Testimonials page, but none of it was captured, so the build has no client voice at all.

Santa Barbara has 2 photos. The scraped /testimonials page holds only footer text and there is no testimonials image folder (probably an embedded widget). 'Daou Winery' is on the About customer list, and the live Contemporary Surround page lived at /daou.
findings.proposal: Owner via the Fable handoff: (1) send any higher-resolution originals and any professional installation shots; commission a styled shoot of 3–4 showroom mantels per style group, plus the color chart. (2) Supply the testimonials from the live /testimonials page, with permission to quote clients by name and town.
